flows.name: HIP initiated linking by demographic details

limitations: The build under test ran on a local machine; ABDM callbacks reached it through a Cloudflare quick tunnel registered as the bridge URL. The tunnel was replaced twice during the run after the machine slept, and the bridge URL re-registered each time (run log).

The build does not store the bodies of its outbound replies and pushes (on-discover, on-init, on-confirm, on-notify, on-request, data push, notify); their content is shown by the code and by ABDM accepting them and by what followed.
ABDM sandbox: one on-discover was answered with 'Runtime Error', and twice no health-information request followed a granted consent (USER_INIT_LINK_607 passes 1 and 2).
Extra checks outside the set (count mismatch ABDM-1037, wrong OTP, consent revocation) were not run.

findings.Health_RECORD_CREATION_101: All 8 HI types are created as NRCES document bundles stored against care contexts, with SNOMED CT and LOINC codes.
findings.HIP_INTI_LINK_504: A record save requests a link token when none is held, stores it for six months, and reuses it for the next link.
findings.HIP_INTI_LINK_505: Care contexts link automatically on save, and a record added to a linked visit sends the context notify (SUCCESS).
findings.HIP_INTI_LINK_506: The linked records were pulled and shown in the PHR app.
findings.USER_INIT_LINK_601: The tester logged in to the PHR app with the second ABHA.
findings.USER_INIT_LINK_602: Ocimum dentistry is found and selected in the PHR app.
findings.USER_INIT_LINK_603: The discover reaches the HIP with the transaction id, patient id and verified identifiers.
findings.USER_INIT_LINK_606: The patient is matched by mobile, with gender and year of birth agreeing.
findings.USER_INIT_LINK_604: Only unlinked care contexts are returned, and the person selects one to link.
findings.USER_INIT_LINK_605: The HIP sends the OTP, verifies it on confirm and links only the selected care context.
findings.USER_INIT_LINK_607: The linked prescription was pulled into the PHR app on the third pass; ABDM sent no data request on the first two.
findings.HIP_INIT_NOTIFY_HIECM: A new record for a patient without ABHA sends sms/notify2 on its own, and the SMS with the deep link arrives.
findings.HIP_INIT_SHARE_CARECONTEXT: Records are shared encrypted on request and shown in the PHR app; there is no screen for stored consents.
